calculation.reason: The Act 995 formula and verified H.15 benchmark changes are preserved, but entry-date selection, the contract-rate comparison, constitutional cap, excluded county warrants, accrual, day count, and payments are not calculator-complete.

branches.noncontract: Ark. Code §16-65-114(a): primary credit rate in effect on judgment entry plus two points
branches.contract: Greater of the contract rate and the statutory primary-credit-plus-two formula
branches.constitutional_cap: The Arkansas Constitution maximum remains controlling
branches.excluded: Interest is not allowed on county warrants or other evidence of county indebtedness

annual_rate.notes: Arkansas’s general statutory reference became 6.00% on September 17, 2026 when the Federal Reserve primary-credit rate became 4.00%; Act 995 adds two percentage points. The judgment-entry date selects the benchmark. Contract judgments compare the contract and statutory rates, the constitutional maximum remains controlling, and county warrants are excluded. Reference only; not legal advice.
